description: Intent i010 (branch xmit-softirq-lock, snapshot s09) complete. FINDING: mwl8k stream_lock context mismatch, drivers/net/wireless/marvell/mwl8k.c:2001-2040, quote 'spin_lock(&priv->stream_lock);', confidence medium. Softirq side: mwl8k_ops .tx = mwl8k_tx (mwl8k.c:5689, def 4762) -> mwl8k_txq_xmit (1907) takes stream_lock with plain spin_lock at 2001/2065/2088/2138; mac80211 reaches .tx from NET_TX softirq (drv_tx at tx.c:1746/4622 and ieee80211_handle_wake_tx_queue -> wake_tx_push_queue at util.c:297/302); the same function takes tx_lock with spin_lock_bh (2073/2130) proving the xmit path runs BH-enabled. Process/workqueue holders of the same stream_lock: mwl8k_watchdog_ba_events worker (INIT_WORK 6203, queued from hardirq mwl8k_interrupt:4691, plain lock at 3906/3919), mwl8k_cmd_set_new_stn_del (4236/4247, via mwl8k_sta_remove 5396 from cfg80211 process context), mwl8k_ampdu_action (5516; plain locks 5533/5574/5595/5613/5624/5631, incl. re-acquire after msleep(1000)). No spin_lock_bh/local_bh_disable on stream_lock anywhere in the file, so a NET_TX softirq on the same CPU can spin forever against a preempted holder -> soft-lockup/RCU-stall/TX-stall DoS, the exact seed mechanism (ks7010 tx_dev_lock shape). Counterevidence checked: softirq-side lock block requires ap_fw + HT STA + QoS data (normal traffic satisfies); no BH-disable variant exists; static analysis only (no .config, no runtime repro). UNRESOLVED candidates: qtnfmac trans.c resp_lock (plain 30/47/87/136; pcie control-RX context not fully traced) and cw1200 wsm.c wsm_cmd.lock (bh kthread vs softirq context unconcluded). SAFE: rtl8723bs xmit path (all _bh/_irqsave, zero plain sites). NOT ANALYZED (limitations): cassini.c (29 plain spin_lock sites), chelsio sge.c, altera_tse_main.c, iwlwifi pcie tx.c, ath9k main.c, mt76. Seed ks7010 absent from s09.
